column4: Visit note | 2025-08-19 10:30 AM | Dr. Zahid Hasan, Gastroenterology | Patient: Hafsa Bepari, 48, female. Mrs. Bepari reports having urgent loose stools every morning with little pain, along with cramping belly pain that feels noticeably worse with stress. She works as a garment merchandiser, and her symptoms have been worse since starting a high-pressure job in Dhanmondi. She denies any blood in her stool, fever, or unexplained weight loss. On examination: pain score 6/10, BP 127/82 mmHg, pulse 82 bpm, weight 84 kg. Her abdomen is soft with mild tenderness over the lower quadrants and normal bowel sounds. Assessment: Irritable bowel syndrome. Plan: lifestyle and self-care advice only, no medicine needed at this stage; no new medicine was prescribed. She was advised to eat regular meals, keep a food diary, and reduce tea, fizzy drinks, and beans. Follow-up in 6 weeks with the food diary.
